summary: Enhance your skills with our Information Systems Auditing Training Course. Learn best practices and techniques to ensure effective IT governance and compliance.
lede: Information systems auditing evaluates technology operations and controls to assess risk and protect data. The course is for IT audit, internal audit, information security, compliance and GRC professionals who need to review technology environments. It covers risk-based audit planning, testing system development and security controls, using data analytics to identify anomalies, and communicating findings through clear audit reports.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals responsible for providing assurance, managing IT risk, or ensuring that technology investments deliver secure and compliant outcomes.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of IT concepts, including networking, operating systems, and databases. At least one year of experience in an audit, security, or IT operations role is recommended. No prior programming or coding knowledge is required for the CAATs module.
